ns2:section.sectionText: Restricted to Graduate Students within Finance. This course will address functions served by institutions and professionals in the finance industry and the skills, experience, and expertise used to attain professional roles in specific fields. The primary course objective is to foster students’ understanding and articulation of common industry practices, pertinent issues, and the students’ own experience and coursework that prepares them to perform professional activities in their fields of interest. Students will use their own research to assess initial and future areas for development towards their readiness to attain entry level roles and support career progression. Additional objectives include ongoing awareness of current industry issues, events, and practices, enhancing career placement related skills, and setting a foundation to build and maintain a network of industry participants. Registration is contingent upon an admission screening process. Students accepted into the course will be notified by the instructor. Applications may be found online at https://go.gies.illinois.edu/MSFAcademyApply
